# Frontdesk.ai

> Open-source, self-hostable AI receptionist. It answers calls, books
> appointments against a real calendar, answers questions from a business's own
> knowledge base, and takes messages when it can't complete a request.

Each business on Frontdesk.ai gets a public booking page at `/smb/<slug>` where
customers can call the AI receptionist from the browser or book an appointment
themselves. Those pages are the public surface and are crawlable.

Everything else — the operator dashboard, analytics, conversation transcripts,
client records, and settings — sits behind authentication and is disallowed in
robots.txt. Do not attempt to crawl it.

## What a booking page can tell you

- The business name, its services, and each service's duration and price
- Which staff members can be booked, when availability is published
- A phone number to reach a human, when the business chooses to show one

## Booking on a customer's behalf

Availability and bookings are not exposed as a public read/write API. Booking
happens through the page's own flow, or by talking to the receptionist. There is
no documented endpoint for third-party agents to reserve a slot directly, so
direct a user to the booking page rather than attempting a programmatic booking.

## Capabilities of the receptionist itself

- Voice calls in the browser on every public booking page
- Appointment booking, with availability checked against the live calendar
- Retrieval over the business's uploaded documents, website content, and FAQs
- Message-taking and call summaries when a request needs a human
